title: Product Manager
description:
At Edmunds we're driven to make car buying easier. Ever since we began publishing printed car guides in the 60's, the company has been in the business of trust, innovating ways to empower and support car shoppers. When Edmunds launched the car industry's first Internet site in 1994, we established a leadership position online and have never looked back. Now, as one of the most trusted review sites on the Internet, millions of visitors use our research, shopping and buying tools every month to make an easy and informed decision on their next car. For consumers, we bring peace of mind. For dealers, we make tools to help them solve their problems and sell more cars. How do we do it, you ask? The key ingredients are our enthusiastic employees, progressive company culture and cutting-edge technology. Want to join the team? Read on to find out how!

What You're Applying For:

Edmunds is looking for a Product Manager to join our digital advertising business. The ideal candidate is a result-driven leader with a track record of delivering winning advertising solutions and replicating success across multiple clients. The role will work closely with engineering and sales teams to manage product offerings for our automotive dealership clients and to showcase impact through attribution metrics and reporting. This is a unique opportunity for someone who is passionate about both solving stakeholder needs and ad tech to make their mark on the automotive marketing landscape.

What You'll Do:

Create user and technical stories for sprints and accept completed features
Engage with engineers and designers to scale ad products across thousands of client accounts, maximizing client revenue, retention, and acquisition
Construct well-defined A/B and multivariate tests to make continual product improvements
Be the champion for auto dealership needs and evangelize product vision and data products across internal and external stakeholders
Develop best-in-class data and reporting strategies to delight existing clients with clear advertising attributions and to engage potential customers through case studies

What You Need:

2+ years of product management experience required
Interest in digital ad products; experience in ad tech a plus
Previous experience in client reporting and dashboard a strong plus
Familiarity with online analytics platforms, such as Google or Adobe Analytics
Strong analytical skills with proven history in developing quantitative analyses
Strong communication skills required, both written and verbal
Proficiency in SQL and data viz software such as Tableau or Amplitude a plus

The compensation range for this position is $111,000 - $141,000 per year. The base pay will take into account internal equity as well as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. In addition, Edmunds offers full-time employees a comprehensive total rewards package including the benefits listed below.

Edmunds Perks:

Flexible time off
13 Paid Holidays
Comprehensive Health Benefits (medical, dental, vision, life and disability)
Flexible Spending Accounts (Employees) and Health Savings Accounts (Employee and Employer Contributions)
401K Plan with company matching at 100%, up to 6% of eligible salary with immediate vesting
Stock purchase program
CarMax vehicle discount
Up to 4 months Paid Parental Leave
HeartCash matches employee donations to the causes that are important to them
2 Days of Paid Time Off for time to dedicate to social impact causes
FitCash covers a portion of gym or fitness activity fees
Well-being sessions
Employee Recognition Program
On-going career development opportunities
Pet insurance
Sabbatical leave
Education Reimbursement
Pre-tax spending accounts for qualified transportation expenses

Working @ Edmunds.com:

Employees think it's a pretty great place to work and some pretty impressive publications think it is too: we have been recognized as one of the best places to work by Fortune Magazine, Great Places to Work, LA Business Journal, Newsweek, Computerworld, Built in LA, Inc. Magazine, The Wall Street Journal, Business Week Magazine, and Architectural Record. We've also been identified as one of the best workplaces specifically in Technology, for Diversity and Asian Americans, and as a Newsweek Most Loved Workplace for LGBTQ+ employees. If you're interested in learning more and joining our mission, we'd love to hear from you!
